entry.name: mc.loudness~
entry.description: The loudness~ object reports the loudness of a signal according to the EBU R 128 standard. Momentary, short term, and integrated loudness measures are reported in LUFS (loudness units referenced to full scale). Additionally, the signal's loudness range is reported in loudness units, while sample peak true peak values are reported in dB. You can use these measurements to normalize audio signals for various broadcast and streaming platforms.

arguments.name: channelcount
arguments.description: If present, a number specifies the number of input signal inlets. The default is a single input signal inlet. When multiple input signals are used, the loudness calculations will be integrated across all signals.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.digest: Reporting Interval (ms)
attributes.description: When theattribute is non-zero, theobject reports loudness values automatically at a specified interval in milliseconds. Measurements for momentary and short-term loudness are taken over a sliding window, so they may change more frequently than the interval measured (400 ms for momentary and 3 seconds for short-term). When theis 0, automatic reporting is disabled and aormessage is required to report the loudness.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Reports all loudness and peak values

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Report all loudness values and a peak value for a specified channel
messages.description: A value of 0 reports the highest sample peak among all input signals, a non-zero value reports the sample peak in a specific input signal.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Reset integrated loudness and peak value calculations
messages.description: Themessage resets the integrated loudness and peak value calculations. You may wish to do this at the beginning of playing back an audio program for which you want a global loudness measurement. These calculations are also reset when restarting audio.

outlets.description: Reports the loudness of the last 400 ms of the input signal(s) in LUFS.
Reports the loudness of the last three seconds of the input signal(s) in LUFS.
Reports the loudness of the entire input signal in LUFS since either the audio was turned on or themessage was received by the object.
Reports the loudness range of the input signal in LU.

Reports the level of the peak sample in a specific channel or all channels in dB. The channel reporting the peak value can be controlled by theattribute or by sending the desired channel tousing anmessage. 0 reports the highest sample peak among all input signals, a non-zero value reports the sample peak in a specific input signal.

Reports the level of the true peak in a specific channel or all channels in dB. The true peak is calculated by oversampling the input to infer a peak between successive samples. The channel reporting the peak value can be controlled by theattribute or by sending the desired channel tousing anmessage. 0 reports the highest sample peak among all input signals, a non-zero value reports the sample peak in a specific input signal.
